title: Chip Transistor Doubling Slowed To 3 Years Instead Of Getting Easier
hook: Chip transistor doubling stretched to 3 years, slowing a once-familiar pace.
closing: More transistors still arrive, but the slower pace means fewer gains to expect between phone upgrades.
question: What actually makes a phone upgrade worthwhile?

segments.say: The supplied Apple phone-chip series reaches 19 billion transistors. Enormous counts can still coexist with slowing progress.
Transistor doubling stretches to 3 years in this comparison. The same multiplication now takes longer.
The latest process-node label is 2 nanometers. It describes a manufacturing generation, not the measured width of every transistor part.
